title: IntentDelta: A Human-Constructed Benchmark for Evolving User Intent
abstract: arXiv:2610.33806v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language-model agents must adapt as users revise their requirements and priorities during complex tasks. We introduce IntentDelta, a human-constructed multi-turn benchmark with 638 trajectories and 3,766 turns across WebShop and TravelPlanner. Each turn pairs a user utterance with a cumulative intention state and human reference actions. The trajectories are cross-verified and cover feasibility- and preference-driven changes in constraints and priorities. We evaluate eleven agents on intention recovery and action quality. Average Intention Recovery is 33.1\% in TravelPlanner and 44.7\% in WebShop, while average Action Score is 31.6% and 41.0%, respectively. Agents struggle to preserve earlier requirements and distinguish soft preferences from must-have constraints. Correct intention recovery also does not guarantee successful execution, highlighting challenges in translating evolving user intentions into actions.

translated_title: IntentDelta：一个面向演化用户意图的人工构建基准
translated_abstract: 语言模型智能体必须能够适应用户在复杂任务中不断修改的需求和优先级。我们提出了 IntentDelta，一个人工构建的多轮基准，涵盖 WebShop 和 TravelPlanner 两个环境，共包含 638 条轨迹和 3,766 个回合。每个回合将用户话语与累积意图状态及人工参考动作配对。这些轨迹经过交叉验证，涵盖了由可行性和偏好驱动的约束与优先级变化。我们在意图恢复和动作质量两方面评估了十一个智能体。平均意图恢复率在 TravelPlanner 中为 33.1%，在 WebShop 中为 44.7%；平均动作得分分别为 31.6% 和 41.0%。智能体难以保留先前的需求，也难以区分软性偏好与必须满足的硬性约束。此外，正确的意图恢复并不保证成功执行，这凸显了将不断演化的用户意图转化为动作所面临的挑战。
tldr: 提出人工构建的多轮基准 IntentDelta（含638条轨迹、3,766个回合），评估显示现有语言模型智能体在跟踪演化用户意图时意图恢复率仅约33%-45%，且难以保留早期需求、区分软偏好与硬约束，正确的意图恢复也不能保证执行成功。
en_tdlr: IntentDelta, a human-constructed multi-turn benchmark with 638 trajectories across WebShop and TravelPlanner, reveals that language-model agents achieve only 33-45% intention recovery, struggle to preserve earlier requirements and distinguish soft preferences from hard constraints, and fail to translate correctly recovered intentions into successful actions.
